kjv: the suburbs thereof for our (the Levites') cattle
mine: their pasturelands for our (the Levites') livestock
note: Migrash is the open common land around a town used for grazing (from garash "drive out" cattle); "suburbs" now suggests residential outskirts. Applies to every "suburbs" in the chapter.
The Hebrew is Qishyon, the town of 19:20, not the river Kishon (Qishon); the KJV spelling conflates them.
